title: Design system
body:
# Design system

Use a quiet canvas, clear type, consistent spacing, subtle rules, and visible focus. Reuse rows, panes, dialogs, and commands across every surface.

title: Product system
body:
# Product system

Work has an outcome and a next action. Decisions include options and a recommendation. Updates report evidence and what happens next.

title: Brand system
body:
# Brand system

Northstar Studio is a fictional demo. Write clearly, use specific verbs, and let the work carry the personality.
